name: boatyard
description: Skills for running several Claude Code agents through one backlog, coordinated over commy and recorded in beads.

compactAtRest.title: Compact at rest
compactAtRest.description: Compact the session at the end of a turn once its free context falls below the threshold.

compactThreshold.title: Compaction threshold
compactThreshold.description: Free context before auto-compact, as a percentage of the space usable before it, below which a session is compacted at rest. BOATYARD_COMPACT_THRESHOLD in a session's environment wins over this.
